title: Arendal
description: arendal.com.mx Revenue $751.1 Million Arendal is a Mexican EPC contractor founded in 1995 in Monterrey, building oil and gas, power, infrastructure and mining projects with its own crews and equipment. It is Mexico's largest pipeline builder and a top two subsea installer in Latin America, with 200 plus projects, a one million pound HDD rig, saturation diving to ADCI and IMCA standards and pipelines moving 3,700 MMscfd of gas. Flagship works include the 452 km 42 inch Los Ramones II Norte gas pipeline with Odebrecht and Techint, Pemex subsea lines in the Bay of Campeche, the El Cuchillo II aqueduct for Monterrey and combined cycle plants up to 600 MW. With subsidiaries HOC Offshore and Arendal HOC Italy it now builds abroad: a 38 inch Vaca Muerta export pipeline in Argentina and a 43 km line for Mellitah in Libya. ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certified, 14 million man hours without lost time accidents. Past Pemex contracts have drawn ASF audit scrutiny.
